import json,urllib.request
base="http://127.0.0.1:17448"
want={
"bridge":"chat-6ac45836-87a0-83ed-bea4-0ad0f99c8982",
"media":"chat-6ac45e9a-66e8-83ed-a34b-4aabeb4aacbf",
"creator":"chat-6ac455e9-bea0-83eb-aa94-fd3dde516c0c",
"growth":"chat-6abf3eb2-40ec-83eb-9f7f-c4a32ad11fc0",
"native":"agent-pc-control",
"qa":"chat-6ac45fb0-9074-83eb-99eb-397265b228e7"}
out={"assignments":{},"snapshot":[]}
allj=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments",timeout=15).read().decode())
rows=allj.get("assignments",[])
for role,cid in want.items():
    xs=[x for x in rows if x.get("targetChatId")==cid]
    xs=sorted(xs,key=lambda x:str(x.get("updatedAt","")),reverse=True)[:3]
    out["assignments"][role]=[{k:x.get(k) for k in ["id","state","lastPreflightReason","lastDiagnostic","dispatchCount","dispatchSubmitAttempted","currentHead","expectedHead","ciRunId","ciConclusion","updatedAt"]} for x in xs]
try:
    snap=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/api/supervisor-watchdog/multiagent-exactid-snapshot",timeout=15).read().decode())
    rows=snap.get("rows",[])
    for role,cid in want.items():
        x=next((z for z in rows if z.get("managedChatId")==cid),None)
        out["snapshot"].append({"role":role,"row":x})
except Exception as e:
    out["snapshot_error"]=type(e).__name__+": "+str(e)
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(",",":")))

note: Read-only six managed chat supervisor and exact-id snapshot after reboot/profile repair
